description: The line plot, titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = small,” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance across six training epochs for four different quantization configurations of the small Whisper model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” spans from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” ranges from 25.0 to 42.5, with major gridlines and tick labels every 2.5 units. Four distinct lines are plotted: “small AdaLoRA_int4” (solid orange line with circular markers) remains relatively stable, starting at approximately 36.0 and ending near 37.0; “small AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed orange line with circular markers) begins at 30.5, peaks sharply at epoch 1 (≈43.5), then declines steadily to ≈38.0 by epoch 6; “small int4” (solid orange line with square markers) starts at 30.5, rises slightly to 31.5 by epoch 2, dips to 31.0 at epoch 4, and ends at 32.0; and “small int8” (dashed orange line with square markers) begins at 30.5, rises to 34.5 at epoch 1, drops to 33.0 at epoch 2, and ends at 31.5 at epoch 6. All lines use orange coloring with varying line styles and marker shapes to distinguish configurations, and the plot includes a legend in the upper right corner.
